zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 已经能编辑 Word、修改幻灯片，也能阅读 PDF。
但只在 Agent 窗口下指令，很难直接指明软件里正在看的那一段或某个局部。
en: Claude Code and Codex can already edit Word documents, revise slides and read PDFs.
But a separate agent window makes it hard to target the exact passage or detail you are looking at.

zh: 我们希望把本机已安装、已登录的 Agent，无缝接入日常工作软件。
依次是 Word、Overleaf、Chrome 中的 PDF、PowerPoint 和 Excel。
en: Our goal is to bring the agents already installed and signed in on your computer into your everyday apps.
Word, Overleaf, PDFs in Chrome, PowerPoint and Excel, in that order.

zh: 选定局部，提出要求，查看差异，确认后再应用。边编辑、边修改、边确认。
在 Chrome 的 PDF 中，则可以选字或框图提问，让每一步操作都精确可控。
en: Select a precise target, request a change, review the diff, then confirm what to apply, right where you work.
For PDFs in Chrome, select text or crop a figure and ask beside the document. Every step stays under your control.

zh: 接下来是在 Chrome 中使用 PDF。LLM_in_PDF 把本机 Agent 接入浏览器里的在线或本地 PDF。
选中文字或框选图表，就能在旁边提问。这里用一份合成示例演示。
en: Next, PDFs in Chrome. LLM_in_PDF connects your local agent to online or local PDFs in the browser.
Select text or crop a figure and ask beside the document. Here we use a synthetic example.
sentences.zh_say: 接下来是在 Chrome 中使用 PDF。LLM in PDF 把本机 Agent 接入浏览器里的在线或本地 PDF。选中文字或框选图表，就能在旁边提问。这里用一份合成示例演示。
sentences.en_say: Next, PDFs in Chrome. LLM in PDF connects your local agent to online or local PDFs in the browser. Select text or crop a figure and ask beside the document. Here we use a synthetic example.

zh: 选中一段文字，点击问一下，就能带着全文上下文提问。
这里让模型区分十四个百分点和百分之十九点四的相对提升。
en: Select a passage and ask a question with the full document as context.
Here the model distinguishes fourteen percentage points from a relative gain of nineteen point four percent.

zh: 再框选图表，发送真实图像，让模型比较两根柱子并说明局限。
回答可以直接显示成表格，也支持公式和代码。
en: Crop a figure to send its actual pixels, then ask about the bars and the limitations.
Answers can include tables, formulas and code.

zh: 刷新后，对话和图片仍然保留。
还可以把整段会话复制成 Markdown，PDF 原文始终不变。
en: Conversations and images remain after reloading.
Copy the complete chat as Markdown. The original PDF stays unchanged.

zh: 五个助手都通过本机桥调用你已登录的命令行工具，不需要额外 API Key。
发送的问题、正文和图片会交给对应模型服务。
en: All five assistants use a local bridge and your signed-in CLI, with no extra API key.
Questions, document context and attached images go to the chosen model provider.

zh: 把本机 Agent 带进日常软件，让每一处操作都看得见、可确认。
在 LLM_in_Work 仓库选择需要的助手，按 README 安装。
en: Bring your local agent into your everyday apps, with precise selections and changes you can review and confirm.
Choose your assistants in the LLM_in_Work repository and follow the README to install.
sentences.zh_say: 把本机 Agent 带进日常软件，让每一处操作都看得见、可确认。在 LLM in Work 仓库选择需要的助手，按 Readme 安装。
sentences.en_say: Bring your local agent into your everyday apps, with precise selections and changes you can review and confirm. Choose your assistants in the LLM in Work repository and follow the Readme to install.
